rules.citation: 29 CFR 1910.120 / API RP 54 Section 20.3 (Hydrogen Sulfide Contingency)
rules.action: Immediate evacuation, muster upwind, don 30-minute positive pressure SCBA, activate rig alarms

rules.regulatory_standard: API Spec 16D (Control Systems for Drilling Well Control Equipment)
rules.citation: API RP 54 Section 6 & API Spec 16D (Well Control & Choke Manifold Integrity)
rules.action: Isolate high-pressure line via upstream hydraulic gate valve, bleed line to 0 PSI, lock out before repair

rules.rule_name: Working at Heights Fall Protection Deficiency
rules.citation: 29 CFR 1926.501 / API RP 54 Section 9.3 (Personal Fall Arrest Systems)
rules.action: Halt derrick activities until 100% dual-lanyard tie-off with certified anchor point is inspected and verified

rules.citation: 29 CFR 1910.147 / API RP 54 Section 21 (Hazardous Energy Control)
rules.action: Halt maintenance, bleed stored energy, apply personal padlocks and tags, verify zero mechanical/hydraulic energy

rules.rule_name: Stop Work Authority Resumed Without Authorized Sign-off
rules.regulatory_standard: API RP 54 (Occupational Safety for Oil & Gas Well Operations)
rules.citation: API RP 54 Section 4.3 (Stop Work Authority) & IADC SMS Policy
rules.action: Immediately suspend operations; conduct mandatory stand-down; require written sign-off from Toolpusher & HSE Specialist

rules.rule_name: Hot Work in Hazardous Atmosphere Without Permit
rules.citation: 29 CFR 1910.119(k) & API RP 54 Section 22 (Hot Work Permits)
rules.action: Extinguish ignition sources, continuously ventilate area, verify continuous LEL monitoring below 10%
Re-equip crew members with task-appropriate PPE before permitting entry into red zone
